annotations.title: Save and read a web page

description: Read a public web page as clean Markdown and save a copy, subject to retention and access settings. Returns the page's text, a short link, QR code and saved-format URLs (.md, .txt, .jpg, .pdf, .mhtml). Successful public copies also return archive_url for the exact version and cite with APA 7, MLA 9, Chicago and BibTeX citations preserving the original source. Those fields are null until a public copy is available. Saving a page does not verify its claims. No account is required. A page saved in the last day may be reused; pass fresh for a new capture.

formats.description: Only these formats (faster for just the text). Default: all of them.

fresh.description: Load the page again even if it was saved in the last day. Default false.

presets.description: Owned Library ids, one per kind. Omit for account defaults; [] skips Library defaults. Explicit link settings win.

url.description: The http or https page to save.
